title.narrative: Protection and Resilience of Independent Sudanese Media (PRISM)

description.narrative: The action will sustain the operations of six key, independent media outlets and the wider network of citizen journalists working with them, enabling them to effectively and safely adapt to the new challenges and potential opportunities presented by the transitional period. It will enhance their ability to safely report and publish uncensored news in a reliable, professional, conflict- and gender-sensitive manner increasing their resilience and fostering their efforts to support civic dialogue

description.narrative: Percentage of Innovation Lab participants reporting improved capacity to utilise and deploy media and digital tools

comment.narrative: 0 NA

100 of 2022 Innovation Lab participants 18 reported improved capacity. Internews conducted a pre and postevaluation survey along with a training evaluation to determine the results of the Innovation Lab and gain indepth feedback from participants. 9 participants 3 female 6 male completed the pre and postassessments and training evaluation. All respondents agreed that at least 70 of the topics presented in the Innovation Lab were useful and could be utilized in their jobs and daily work. The results indicated that the most useful and interesting topics covered were 1 Investigative Journalism 2 the Digital Sudan Lab 3 Digital Services GTH and 4 Editorial Ethics.Year3 interim report Annex 3

comment.narrative: Checklist completed

1 out of 6 media outlets.Internews OCA evaluated the financial resilience of all 6 partners. 1 partner Zr13 showed improvement and achieved a score of 100. Zr6 also scored 100 but this is not reported as an increase since their baseline score was also 100. 2 out of 6 media partners Zr14 and Zr6 were successful in maintaining the same high baseline score which was attributed to their strong financial management practices and effective resource allocation strategies. On the other hand 3 media partners Zr1 Zr8 and Zr9 experienced a decline in their resilience score compared to the baseline and midline assessments. Interim report year3 Annex 4.
